basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed Software Engineer | GenAI PoC to Production | Customer-Embedded Delivery
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who owns AI initiatives from discovery through production. Full-time Lead Software Engineer at LumApps: I build multi-agent workflows that unify Salesforce, HubSpot and other systems of record into one agent memory, ship in weeks not quarters, and stay on-call for what I ship. 13+ years running production software for customers, not just writing it: replaced a $337K vendor contract with an LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks at Beekeeper, founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery platform at Dronistics, and founder of Anand Creations, a forward deployed practice and the home for the GenAI products I build and ship myself. I ship the 20% that unblocks the customer's real problem, not the 80% that looks good in a demo.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Full-time Lead Software Engineer owning AI agent delivery end-to-end: from discovery through production and on-call, a you-build-it-you-run-it model I already apply daily.
highlights: Own AI agent delivery end-to-end, from discovery through production and on-call, staying accountable for what I ship: a you-build-it-you-run-it model.

Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, integrating tools over MCP servers with agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $1M in quarterly revenue.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer: owns the problem, builds the PoC, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Integrated AI agents into customer-facing sales and product workflows for a platform used by millions.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks (prototype to production). 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.
Built GenAI demo system for sales that auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. Improved demo speed and close rates.
Ran observability and on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting for everything I shipped.

work.name: Tenity

highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics

Built cloud infrastructure and DevOps pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: The inbox was never built to run a business. Orders get missed, RFQs go cold, and every line gets retyped into the ERP by hand, one email, one PDF, one WhatsApp message at a time. We built AI Coworkers that do most of the repetitive work nobody wants to do instead: they read what comes in, sort it, draft linked actions, and post clean entries straight into the customer's systems of record. We are looking for a Forward-Deployed Software Engineer to become the technical face of Hoshii: run on-site discovery, build working PoCs in days, take them to production, and own them operationally after go-live. Requirements: strong fullstack coding (Python, JS/TS), proven GenAI PoC to production experience, systems integration judgment (APIs, data pipelines, event-driven architectures), 80/20 pragmatism, direct customer-facing experience, ERP/CRM familiarity a plus, English and German C1+.
